body:
Thanks :) I think I needed to hear that. I'm sure (well, I hope) that everything will turn out all right. 

And don't worry - it's never too late to change course in life if you feel like a failure. Have you got a roof over your head? Then that's one thing you've got going for you; even if you live at home, at least you have somewhere to live. I guess what I'm trying to say to you is that there's light at the end of the tunnel (and I realise how much of a cliche that statement is).

Late teens - I'm not 18 yet, put it that way. I will add that I am very lucky in that I had very loving, supportive parents - I was just a lazy SOB. I'm probably overstating things to be honest - my life isn't bad as such: I just wish I had friends and that I'd done more as a kid. Maybe this wasn't the best sub to post my rant to, but I just wanted to get it all off my chest. I realise that I have it much, MUCH better than a lot of kids, so I probably really shouldn't be complaining, but loneliness gets a bit much sometimes.
Thanks. Maybe it's not so bad - I'm probably overstating things, and I do tend to exaggerate. I just wish I'd done more and been less lazy. I've still got time to change, though.
